summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for the underfollowed optical-interconnect / compound-semiconductor epitaxy node. The best Layer-1B fit is not the headline GPU or optical-module layer, but the upstream chain: MOCVD / deposition tools, InP/GaAs substrates, laser/driver integration, and optical-engine packaging. Reference anchors such as Lumentum and Coherent are useful for context, but this pass emphasizes smaller or less obvious public assets: Veeco as the tool-chain candidate, AXT as the substrate candidate, Semtech as a hidden InP/driver integration candidate after HieFo, and POET as a speculative optical-engine packaging candidate. No buy/sell view is implied.
